Package com.wac.autocore.test

  • Class Summary 
    Class Description
    CancelledOrdersProof
    The work order list keeps the cancelled orders out, and the road back to one still works.
    ErrorBoundaryProof
    A12: an invalid customer number is a rule violation with a message worth reading, and a database that stops answering is another kind of error.
    OldDatabaseProof
    L3: a database created before the changes has to start the program and read as before.
    WorkOrderProof
    Proves that a work order can be created, changed and confirmed with no window in the way, so the rule about running the business outside the ui rests on a run and not on a document.
    WorkOrderRowsProof
    B5: the same work order, created, changed and cancelled, has to leave the same rows in the database no matter who asks for it.
